info.title: ralphus daemon API
info.description: HTTP/JSON API of the ralphus daemon. Every operation requires `Authorization: Bearer <daemon token>` (the token is not part of this document) except `GET /api/events`, which takes a single-use ticket. Most operations declare generic JSON bodies; the human-readable reference is docs/daemon-api.md. Listing an operation here is not permission to invoke it: authorization is enforced per request.

get.description: Streaming response (`text/event-stream`) that stays open until the client disconnects. It bypasses the bearer check: authenticate with a single-use `ticket` minted by `POST /api/events/ticket`. Each frame is `event: <kind>` plus `data: <json>`; periodic heartbeats keep the connection alive.
